summary: Iteration 4 regression verification of the PhedFieldSurvey filtered() fix. The former early return that let searched rows bypass pendingOnly has been removed (line 163 now unconditionally applies '!isAdmin && pendingOnly && isSurveyed(p) => false'). Verified end-to-end. Frontend (Playwright, surveyor1 @ THS, mobile 390 & 360): (1) /employee/phed-survey with filter-pending + NO query -> THS-0001 not listed, field-property-empty-state visible; (2) filter-pending + search 'THS-0001' -> THS-0001 STILL NOT listed and field-property-empty-state visible (fix works); (3) filter-all + search 'THS-0001' -> exactly one row field-property-6abd2d41-a7fc-479d-992a-3a72558b30aa visible with 'Submitted' badge; (4) /employee/properties map-bottom-info-bar shows 'Total: 3 properties / Pending 0 / Submitted / review 2 / Approved 1' (THS-0001 not counted as pending); (5) at 360px, document.scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 on BOTH /employee/phed-survey and /employee/properties (no horizontal overflow). Backend (pytest 5/5 PASS via existing /app/backend/tests/test_phed_iter3_post_submit.py against external URL): /api/phed/my-progress -> total=3, pending=0, in_progress=0, completed=3; /api/map/employee-properties -> THS-0001 phed_survey_status=Submitted / state=Submitted / outcome=LOCKED; admin /api/phed/surveys?property_id=THS-0001 -> exactly one non-rejected survey with reference_number=PL0001, reference_code=PL, status=Submitted, property_record_id=6abd2d41-a7fc-479d-992a-3a72558b30aa; auth guard rejects unauthenticated calls. No data modifications performed.
